prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / Chinese xianxia game concept art.
The reference is the PREVIOUS concept that the user says looks TOO MUCH LIKE A COMPUTER CIRCUIT BOARD. Redesign it into a convincing immortal-cultivation FORMATION DISK, while keeping an absolutely top-down view and distinct installable component-like objects. This is a substantial visual redesign, not adding a few cloud ornaments to the same electronics.

KEEP: complete circular handheld artifact silhouette, strict 90-degree orthographic top view, four individually readable assembled components, clear non-crossing connections, hidden layout grid, transparent exterior.
REPLACE: modern motherboard styling, black IC housings, rows of processor pins, solder-pad grids, industrial screw holes, machine-panel vent slots, large octagonal CPU packaging and copper electrical wiring.

OVERALL IMAGE: a refined Chinese xianxia ritual formation disk made of warm grey-celadon jade/stone, weathered ancient bronze and fine cinnabar inlay. Soft elegant hand-painted ink-and-color game art, tactile jade grain and patinated metal, precise crafted detail. The object should immediately read as an ancient cultivator's formation instrument. It remains orderly and assembled, with real modular parts, rather than a generic magic circle, jewelry collection or a computer. There are no people or flags.

DISK BODY: entirely rework the old industrial rim and dark PCB face. Use a shallow celadon-grey jade disk with a restrained aged-bronze edge. Around the outer annulus, engrave two or three fine concentric formation rings, occasional tiny abstract seal-script incisions, eight discreet directional notches and elegant cloud-thunder motifs. Ornament stays subordinate to the functional layout; leave breathing room across the inner working face. No modern fasteners, chip contacts around the disk, a giant yin-yang symbol, a complete preprinted spell diagram, or chessboard squares.

COMPONENTS: they should be small functional immortal-crafting modules, with fitted jade pieces, bronze mortises, thin caps and actual inset connection mouths, but NO electronic pin arrays or processor package shells. Redraw all four:
- Upper-left sensing component: a compact three-lobed bronze-and-jade listening core with folded cloud-shaped lamellae and one slender milky-jade needle. It is a precise assembled part, not a crosshair, bow or decorative pendant.
- Near the middle, slightly left: the main formation eye, built from four fitted notched jade arcs around a small quiet milky spirit core, with a narrow ancient-bronze mounting ring and delicately engraved miniature talisman strokes. Make it distinctly a formation pivot, not a giant CPU, steering wheel, eyeball or precious-stone jewel.
- Lower-left: a horizontal, single-piece spirit-storage component, a slim bamboo-jointed jade-and-bronze chamber holding softly clouded spirit marrow, with restrained ancient mortise bands. No battery pictogram, transparent modern tank, electrical connectors or industrial clamps.
- Right-middle: a vertical protective formation component consisting of two opposing slim ruyi/cloud-shaped jade arcs in a compact bronze mortise frame, with an open center. Its outline is an abstract array mechanism. Absolutely no shield shape, shield symbol, weapon or bow. It should still clearly look like one installable functional component.

TWO CONNECTING SYSTEMS, IN THE LANGUAGE OF FORMATION INSCRIPTIONS:
1. Signal “脉纹”: a narrow cinnabar seal-ink route delicately recessed into the disk, with slightly organic etched edges and occasional tiny talisman knots at transitions. It runs from the sensor toward the top connection of the protective component. One readable route, not a bundle of parallel GPIO lines.
2. Energy “灵络”: a slightly broader but still delicate pale celadon-white spirit vein in a shallow carved groove, containing wisps of quiet light and mineral-grain texture. It runs from the storage component along the lower face into the bottom of the protective component. No framed plumbing pipe, gold electrical busbar, metal clips, thick colored ribbon or neon.
Each path really joins the inset mouths of its components. Paths stay flat against the disk, harmoniously follow the available face with clean continuous bends, remain separate and NEVER cross. Do not flood the face with arbitrary connected decoration. Keep a clear hierarchy between these functional paths and the faint outer engraved formation rings.

VIEW AND QUALITY: absolutely overhead orthographic; circular rings remain circular, no perspective tilt, no isometric camera, no visible front-facing side walls. Unified soft overhead lighting with only fine contact shading. Restrained glow only in spirit marrow and working veins, no bloom, sparks or floating holograms. Calm refined immortal-crafting aesthetics, readable individual silhouettes and material changes.
NO visible grid, checkerboard, square cell outlines, labels, title, numbers, UI chrome, arrows or watermark.
True transparency outside the finished artifact.
